note: All 15 learning scenarios through the fix-and-verify loop with today's defaults: production framing, expected numbers stated before a fix, a round that does not help rolled back after two observation windows (tag loop-v2, 2026-11-17, deepseek-flash, no SOP, one run each, up to 3 rounds). Graded by reading every round. BH02, BH05 and BH06 are reruns: their first attempts overlapped with a second run on the same cluster and were discarded.
